page.layout: One column of running text, with ink marks in both margins. Right margin: small marks only, no text. Left margin: stray marks at the edge, not printed text. Below the text, at the right: catchword "Lacc-".

main_text.p: dissuafore se, arbitrium liberum de hac permissum urbe fuerat, nunc totum id ab se rejicere: respondisse[?] enim legatis Lacedæmoniorum, re[?] eorum ad se nihil pertinere: cupere autem eos, qui nunc rerum Lacedæmone potissimum potiuntur, Achaicæ societatis & reipublicæ fieri participes, quorum desiderio si morem gesterimus, inquiebat, duo perquàm utilia nobis assequemur: nam tum eos nobis jungemus, qui semper Achæorum genti benevoli & fidi fuerunt, & deinceps ejus decreta probaturi & confirmaturi sunt, & pro accepto beneficio parem gratiam volentibus diis, nobis relaturi; tum cum veteribus exulibus, quorum ingratos atque impios animos experti sumus, sponte suâ urbe decessuris, &-melioribus locum in ea daturis, in republicâ nihil habituri sumus commune. Verum obsistebat Diophanes, & qui cum eo faciebant, semper adversantes consiliis Lycortæ, & jam è vivis sublati Philopœmenis: monebantque Achæos, ne in gratiam paucorum urgerent & praeinerent[?] etiam ipsi fortunam misero-extorrium[?], qui contra jus & fas â ejecti essent.

page.notes: Left margin: stray marks ("s: mm :", "2: uuu : s2 :", "& &", "s: mm :2s: mm") lie outside the text block; they look like ink marks or show-through and are not transcribed as text. Right margin: small dashes, arrows and marks, not text. The ink blot over "respondisse" and "re" leaves those words doubtful. The word "inerent" is partly covered by a left-margin mark and is read as "inerent"; the reading "praeinerent" in the text is a guess and should be checked against the scan. "misero-" ends the line and "extorrium" begins the next; the word may be misread. Running head read as "DESCRIPTIO" with a glyph in the middle; the page number 410 is at top left.
